Independent grading differentiates actual material source support, causal mechanism transfer, counterexample, abstention and harmful confidence from merely syntactically correct citation and rejects CAA self-score authority.

A bounded caller-invoked, disabled-by-default shadow evaluator collects no workflow-control actions; absent provider, failed optional consultation, Human opt-out or budget exhaustion leaves original direct Brain flow unchanged.

An exact authenticated pre-registered Human EvaluationPlan binds sampling, rubric, thresholds, privacy, provider, max spend/calls/duration and stop conditions before decisive holdout/live shadow; hard ceilings 50 subjects, 7 days and one advisor call per subject are enforced without implying authorization.

Four-flow adversarial fixtures reject label contamination, source/citation swap, future events, injection, causal false analogy, incorrect judge provenance, budget violations and unauthenticated Human rollout.

hard: Use exact authenticated sealed CAA-01 ExperienceCut/source/as-of and existing CAA-02/03 interfaces. The evaluation surface only consumes caller-authorized four-flow input; hashes and JSON reports never authenticate their own sources.

Keep development fixtures, sealed holdout and shadow subjects distinct; independent labels and rubric cannot be passed into advisor input. Reject stale/swapped source, subject, policy, candidate, later RUN/REVIEW exposure and changed main.

Before decisive offline holdout or live shadow, require a trusted pre-registered EvaluationPlan with exact population/source, metrics and thresholds, independent grader provenance, permissions, allowed provider/effort, cost/time/call ceilings and rollback/disable plan; unapproved/missing plan must stop evaluation, not ordinary lawful Brain work.

Implementation safety limits: shadow at most 50 eligible subjects or 7 days, whichever first; maximum one selected advisor call per subject; existing CAA-03 time/source/provider caps also apply. These are ceilings only and grant no automatic Human approval to run or spend.

Shadow must be read-only, caller-invoked, explicitly opt-in and finite. Unavailable advisor, opt-out, invalid evaluation-only data or exhausted budget cannot block otherwise lawful direct TASK/REPAIR/REMEDIATION/ARCHITECTURE work; genuine existing canonical auth errors remain blocking.
